task.goal: Build branch-local three-slot Golden Triangle orchestration plus control-console self-metabolism without main writes.
required_behaviors: exactly three logical slots A/B/C; slot 4 is rejected
new authorized window/worker takes over an existing slot via durable handoff and never increments slot count
A can dispatch B and C by durable packet/lease without visible browser window dependency
worker restart resumes from durable state and rejects already-consumed packets
branch-local workflow proves A->B->C->A with separate jobs and artifacts while contents permission remains read-only
control-console self-metabolism compacts duplicate/transient control-plane events into deterministic summary and WASTE/QUARANTINE dispositions
self-metabolism never reads or deletes secret-like content, protected evidence, rollback anchor, Identity/Personality/Governance, or user chat history
full backup groups remain exactly RECOVERY_BASELINE and WORKING_EXCHANGE only
negative_tests: duplicate worker registration does not create slot
secret-like control-plane item quarantined without content retention

acceptance: compile and unit tests reproducibly pass
no fourth slot or third full backup
one compact Evidence and one B->C packet
workflow candidate is branch-local and read-only
